scope: Current single-owner project's initial teaching prior; not a default diagnosis for other users

observations.reading: Good performance on self-reported English II reading-related items; relatively stronger written receptive ability
observations.speaking: Can make simple expressions on familiar matters; unfamiliar matters are difficult to initiate; cause may include planning, lexical retrieval, construction and interaction

initialTaskRange.reading: Provisionally try B2-like general-interest authentic materials with local support; adjust using actual comprehension, never infer measured CEFR
initialTaskRange.productiveStartingPoint: B1-like complete communication tasks on familiar matters; B2-like explanation, comparison and follow-up as stretch
initialTaskRange.repair: If needed, break the same communicative purpose into A2-like short exchanges before rejoining it; this does not lower the chapter vocabulary challenge
initialTaskRange.levelMeaning: Task-design references only; not the learner's certified or measured level

selectionGuidance: Use approximate recognition as support, not mastery of the entire word or family
Include valuable advanced senses, collocations and constructions of familiar-looking words
Prefer complementary resources that make a complete communicative act possible, alongside worthwhile outward expansion
Distinguish missing ideas, retrieval, construction and pronunciation problems before prescribing new vocabulary
Keep complete dual-textbook meanings and real families; do not lower overall challenge, reward rarity, filter by owner, or force level proportions
Permit natural relationships including shared context, but do not actively optimize sharing, graph density or coverage-per-word
Revise the candidate frontier from actual feedback; freeze each run's original input and never rewrite earlier snapshots
